about_short_description.short_description: Saudi German Hospital offers medical care services.

product.name: Hospital Medical Care Services
product.description: Comprehensive medical care delivered through outpatient consultations, inpatient treatment, clinical departments, and coordinated care pathways for patients with varied health needs.

product.name: Emergency and Urgent Care
product.description: Immediate assessment and treatment for patients with acute illnesses, injuries, and other conditions requiring prompt medical attention.

product.name: Outpatient Specialist Consultations
product.description: Scheduled consultations with medical specialists for diagnosis, treatment planning, follow-up, and management of ongoing health conditions.

product.name: Inpatient Care
product.description: Hospital-based treatment and monitoring for patients who require admission, clinical observation, procedures, or recovery support.

product.name: Surgical Services
product.description: Preoperative, operative, and postoperative care for patients requiring surgical procedures across relevant medical specialties.

product.name: Diagnostic and Laboratory Services
product.description: Medical testing and imaging used to identify conditions, guide treatment decisions, monitor health status, and support clinical procedures.
